headline: Kimberly-Clark Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: The board of directors of Kimberly-Clark Corporation (NASDAQ: KMB) has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.28 per share. The dividend is payable in cash on October 2, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 4, 2026.

headline: Divided Tech, Divided Fed: Navigating AI Capex Scrutiny And Mixed Macro Signals
